question: What form is endowed with window-hall mouth and joined with two-corner round head?
premises: dvyaśravṛttaśiroyuktaṃ means two corner round head joined
netraśālāmukhānvitam means window hall mouth endowed
inference: The form is joined with two-corner round head and endowed with window-hall mouth.
plain_english: It is joined with a two-corner round head and endowed with a window-hall mouth.
